historical_source.lineage: later stable descendant of the Y2/Yaksa numerical-divergence line

historical_behavior.blackhole_trigger: bias NaN/Inf or max absolute finite weight above 25
historical_behavior.blackhole_candidate: clip weights and finite bias to [-3,3], replace non-finite bias with 0, set lr_scale=0.6
historical_behavior.state_sanitization: input_keys<=64; finite weights clipped [-10,10]; non-finite weights dropped; bias finite/clipped [-10,10]; history tail<=64
historical_behavior.training_bounds: prediction clipped [-1000,1000], target [-200,200], error [-50,50], active weights/bias [-10,10]

modern_repairs: non-finite weights are an explicit trigger rather than relying on max(abs(weight)) behavior around NaN
candidate weights/state are returned as receipts instead of being applied in-place
learning-rate change is proposal data only
no model load/save authority is inherited

y2_boundary.interpretation: Yaksa+11 provides a source-backed repaired descendant; it is not proof of byte-level Y2 equivalence
